aliases: Sword Saint Nian Er's true inheritance Nian Er Sword Saint true inheritance

summary.text: Sword Saint true inheritance is the sword path legacy left by Nian Er tribe's rank eight Sword Saint Nian Er. It is split into three portions with a hard, deadly test, and inheritors are rare.

claims.text: At Iron Eagle blessed land, Nian Er Fu confirms that Nian Er Ping Zhi obtained the Sword Saint true inheritance and was kept in the tribe by the first supreme elder for ten years before this first outing. Other righteous path Gu Immortals name Sword Saint Nian Er a former rank eight of Nian Er tribe who once cultivated light path, then switched to sword path, and left this true inheritance after death with an extremely difficult and deadly test, so actual inheritors are rare. The inheritance is said to be split into three portions: after the first round and the first portion, the inheritor is known as the Sword Child; later talk ties a second portion to the title Swordmaster.
Nian Er Ping Zhi has rank six cultivation and has inherited only a portion of the Sword Saint true inheritance, which is not enough against a rank seven expert such as Old Monster Corpse Poison.

Hei Fan and Nian Er Sword Saint are named as prideful historical figures who set difficult requirements so useless people would not obtain their inheritances. For Nian Er tribe’s Nian Er Sword Saint true inheritance, an inheritor appears only every few hundred years, and the current one is Nian Er Ping Zhi.
Others call Nian Er Ping Zhi the current inheritor of Sword Saint Nian Er’s true inheritance.

Nian Er Yi Fang names sword heart clarity as an immortal killer move in the Sword Saint true inheritance used especially to restrict wisdom path and similar methods, and says few Sword Childs in history could use it. Chu Du judges that the move Nian Er Ping Zhi uses to kill Granny Yin is one sword life, an immortal killer move Sword Saint Nian Er used in his younger days.
